people.name: Areopagus
people.line: A hill in Athens where Paul preached the gospel.

people.name: Damaris
people.line: Woman who believed Paul's message in Athens

people.name: Dionysius
people.line: Areopagite who believed Paul's message in Athens

translations.web: But certain men joined with him and believed, among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
translations.bsb: But some joined him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, a woman named Damaris, and others who were with them.
translations.kjv: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
translations.asv: But certain men clave unto him, and believed: among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
